articles.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
articles.snippet: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

articles.title: Trump's Democratic SEC pick suggests tokenization policy deserves full rule process
articles.snippet: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee held a confirmation hearing for the two nominees — one from each party — as the administration rebuilds the markets regulators.

articles.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion feezing order against hackers behind crypto's largest theft
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange said it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

articles.title: Crypto traders vs. Wall Street: OKX’s Anthropic markets put IPO pricing to the test
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange plans to launch tokenized Anthropic shares as its pre-IPO futures trade about 24% above the company’s $83 offering price.

articles.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
articles.snippet: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week. Holders of the rest can demand cash on Nov. 30, and its bitcoin is worth just under $1 billion.
